test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: If 27 men take 15 days to mow 225 hectares of grass, how long will 33 men take to mow 165 hectares?
solution:
**Given:**

27 men take 15 days to mow 225 hectares.

Number of men = 33

Area = 165 hectares

**Formula used:**

Work = Men × Days

Men × Days (1) ÷ Area (1) = Men × Days (2) ÷ Area (2)

**Calculations:**

(27 × 15) ÷ 225 = (33 × Days) ÷ 165

⇒ (405) ÷ 225 = (33 × Days) ÷ 165

⇒ 1.8 = (33 × Days) ÷ 165

⇒ Days = (1.8 × 165) ÷ 33

⇒ Days = 297 ÷ 33

⇒ Days = 9

**∴ 33 men will take 9 days to mow 165 hectares.**
